title: What is the virtual DOM and how does reconciliation work?
description: Understand React's virtual DOM and diffing algorithm.

data.text: **Question:** What is the virtual DOM and how does reconciliation work?

The virtual DOM is an in-memory representation of the real DOM. Reconciliation is the process of comparing the new virtual DOM with the previous one and applying only the changed elements to the real DOM.

**Virtual DOM:**
- Lightweight JavaScript object
- Represents UI structure in memory
- Created on every render
- Much faster than real DOM operations

**Reconciliation:**
- Compares new virtual DOM with previous
- Identifies changed elements (diffing)
- Batches updates to real DOM
- Uses keys for efficient list updates
